title: WINDOW with negative ABS bounds counts from the end of the partition
query: EVALUATE WINDOW ( -2, ABS, -1, ABS, ALL ( 'Product'[Product] ), ORDERBY ( 'Product'[Product], ASC ) )

source.quote: If from is negative, it's the position of the start of the window from the end of the partition. -1 means the last row in the partition.
source.supports: -2, ABS is the second last row and -1, ABS the last; the last row is included

derivation: Products ascending: Bike, Helmet, Lock, Scooter. The second last is Lock, the last Scooter.
